rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` has the front matter that marks a bundled skill, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill put specialized material in files it points to. It requires each such pointer to say when to read the file.

The file points to specialized material in two places:
- **`references/review-prompt.md`:** Workflow step 3 (Review) tells the supervising agent to have each review subagent read this file. The pointer is tied to that step and to starting a subagent for each requirement group. If subagents can't be started, the step has the agent review against the prompt itself. That says when to read it.
- **`references/fixme.md`:** This file belongs to the habeas-evidence skill. The "Choosing references" section points to it only for the case "To defer a requirement gap the user agrees to, use `{fixme}` as the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` describes". The condition for reading it is explicit.

I found no other pointer to a specialized file. Mentions of other skills' `SKILL.md` and sections are routine cross-references with a stated context, not links to specialized material. The site has no gap against the requirement.

The violation queries listed no matches, so there was nothing further to judge.
